query_fields.rationale: A concrete MW/kW target for PV on city-owned roofs can be estimated from peer-city plans or municipal targets.
A rooftop PV deployment target for private buildings is a numeric quantity that can be estimated from comparable city policies.
Whether Aachen mandates solar on new buildings is a legal/policy detail that is city-specific rather than a generic numeric quantity.
Whether solar is required on major roof renovations depends on the exact local legal text and exemptions, not a peer-derived proxy.
The existence and design of a city subsidy or grant program is qualitative and city-specific.
City-run advice, outreach, or technical support programs are policy descriptions rather than estimable quantities.
Permit-process changes, expedited review, or administrative simplification are procedural and legally specific, not numerical.
